metadata.scope: Curated US financial-operations pilot; not a representative market sample or adoption rate.
metadata.coverage_note: Three sourced initiatives. Tokenized fund activity remains unmeasured. Record counts are coverage counts, not market penetration.
metadata.volume_aggregation: none: heterogeneous and potentially overlapping workflows

records.rail: DTCC private Besu network and Canton
records.asset_legal_claim: Tokenized representations of DTC-custodied securities; rights described by DTCC, not an independent legal assessment.
records.geography: United States securities; international institutional participants

stage_evidence.details: DTCC reported real transactions across several workflows during a several-hour production event. October 2026 was a planned service launch, not evidence of recurring use.

sources.title: DTCC turns tokenization into reality: production trades

recurring_evidence.details: Re-reviewed 2026-10-17. DTCC's current official hub still describes the service launch as expected in 4Q 2026; the July event alone does not establish sustained production activity.

volume.note: Event notional and eligible-market denominator were not disclosed. DTCC-wide figures are excluded.

records.customer_visibility: Institutional workflows; end-investor experience not established by this release.

operating_evidence.note: Potential efficiencies were described without measured event-level cost or prefunding outcomes.

control_implications: Hypothesis: reconcile tokenized positions and entitlements to custody records.
Hypothesis: assess asset conversion, wallet permissions, collateral movement and settlement evidence.

procurement_evidence.details: No assurance purchase or RSM engagement identified in this source.

records.next_review_question: Verify launch status and dated repeat activity; do not promote stage when the planned launch date arrives.

records.asset_legal_claim: USDC stablecoin used to prefund eligible cross-border payouts; not a bank deposit or a claim of cash or tax equivalence.
records.geography: Eligible Visa Direct clients and partners; specific availability varies by geography

stage_evidence.details: Visa reported that Inyo Global became the first enabler to bring Visa Direct stablecoin prefunding into commercial production for eligible clients and partners.

sources.title: Visa Direct launches stablecoin-powered money movement as pilots move to production

recurring_evidence.details: The source describes commercial production and day-to-day operations but supplies only one dated observation, so repeat activity is not yet documented under this methodology.

volume.note: No Inyo-specific payout or prefunding volume, client count, or eligible-market denominator reported.

records.customer_visibility: Businesses can use the same Inyo APIs they already use; the recipient experience is not established by this source.

operating_evidence.availability: Near-real-time USDC prefunding and around-the-clock funding are reported for eligible clients.
operating_evidence.note: The source describes an alternative to traditional funding windows but provides no measured liquidity, cost, or prefunding reduction.

control_implications: Hypothesis: reconcile USDC prefunding to payout obligations and treasury books.
Hypothesis: assess wallet authorization, sanctions controls, liquidity cutoffs and processor dependencies.

procurement_evidence.details: No assurance purchase or RSM engagement identified in this source.

records.next_review_question: Seek a second dated production observation, Inyo-specific volume, eligible geographies, and measured liquidity or funding-window outcomes.

records.asset_legal_claim: USDC stablecoin; not a bank deposit or a claim of cash or tax equivalence.

stage_evidence.details: Visa reported Cross River and Lead Bank had begun USDC settlement. Access remained selective within its pilot.

sources.title: Visa launches stablecoin settlement in the United States

recurring_evidence.details: Re-reviewed 2026-10-17. Visa has since reported broader global pilot growth, but no source provides two dated observations or volumes for either named US bank. Global annualized figures cannot be assigned to this US cohort.

volume.note: No US-cohort volume or eligible-market denominator reported.

records.customer_visibility: Consumer card experience unchanged, according to Visa.

operating_evidence.note: No measured cost or prefunding reduction for the named banks disclosed.

control_implications: Hypothesis: reconcile token settlement to network obligations and bank books.
Hypothesis: assess wallet authorization, cutoff, liquidity and third-party controls.

procurement_evidence.details: No assurance purchase or RSM engagement identified in this source.

records.next_review_question: Seek dated US-bank repeat usage, volumes, corridors, and measured operating outcomes.
